:::{#def-sufficient}
#### Sufficient statistic

Let $\vX$ be a discrete sample whose distribution depends on a parameter $\param$.
A [statistic](#def-statistic) $\statf{\vX}$ is **sufficient** for $\param$
if, for every sample $\vx$ and every value $t$,
the conditional probability of the sample given the statistic
is the same for every value of $\param$ at which the statistic takes the value $t$
with positive probability:

$$
\Pr_{\param}\paren{\vX = \vx \given \statf{\vX} = t}
\text{ does not depend on } \param
\quad \text{wherever } \Pr_{\param}\paren{\statf{\vX} = t} > 0
$$ {#eq-sufficient}
:::
